comments.body:
I would use a StringBuilder instead of a StringBuffer on line 96.

Does the container_search table need the loan_id and transaction_guid columns?

Not sure if this is significant, but previously, if the event wasn’t going to have any extra data in line 111, the extra data parameter would be null. Now, if the event doesn’t have any extra data in line 112, the extra data parameter is an empty string. May be inconsequential, but a difference we should be aware of.

Is line 321 something that needs to be addressed?

I’m a little curious as to why there is a ?xhtml in line 430, but there isn’t on in any of the other lines 427 - 434? Is it possible you’re doubly escaping in line 430? Or are all those other values not being escaped?

Indentation is off in lines 473 and 474.

Line 11 and 12 kind of seem like they are duplicating 388 and 394. Not sure if that’s avoidable or not.

Dan Bender I forgot to add the db script for container_search. Good catch.

Ken HopkinsI will update 111 & 112 to pass in a null again. Line 321 I do want to address. The field order in the hide/show columns is inconsistent. I’ll look into the escaping in datatableJSONResponse and try to consolidate the label text assignments.

• Change StringBuffer to StringBuilder
  • Added database scripts
  • if additionalInfo is empty, then pass eventExtraData.
  • For the previous todo - Show /hide column order (top-down) actually corresponds to the search results column order(left-right). This seems okay.
  • updated indentation
  • populate the DatatableColumn text field from bean property reference.

I’m curious why, in the migration script, you are dropping the columns if they exist and recreating them - rather than creating the columns when they don’t exist? It seems like, if this were run on an existing database, with existing data, that data would be wiped out. Is that intentional?

Dan Bender Old habits resurfacing. It provides “rollback” code.

I’m not attached to it. I guess I should be following the norm. I’ll update to only add is the column is not there.
don't wipe out existing data if script is re-applied.
Not a huge deal, but I don’t think the Setter annotation in TransferReceiptTransformer.java is needed.
